_comment: Copy this file to llm_config.json and fill in your own values. llm_config.json is git-ignored, so your key never gets committed. Every field can also be overridden by an environment variable (BRFL_LLM_PROVIDER / BRFL_LLM_MODEL / BRFL_LLM_BASE_URL / BRFL_LLM_API_KEY / BRFL_LLM_TEMPERATURE / BRFL_LLM_TOP_K / BRFL_LLM_TIMEOUT).
_provider_help: 'dashscope' = Aliyun DashScope native SDK (base_url is ignored). 'openai' = any OpenAI-compatible /chat/completions endpoint (OpenAI, DeepSeek, DashScope compatible-mode, vLLM, Ollama, ...), in which case base_url is required.
